svg.aria-label: One credit model, one cutoff, made-up counts for two groups of 1,000 applicants. The base rates differ: 900 would repay in group A and 750 in group B. Error rates are level: 10% of the people who would repay are declined in both groups, and 30% of the people who would default are approved in both. Predictive value is apart: 96% of approvals are repaid in A against 90% in B. Selection rates are apart: 84% of A is approved against 75% of B. Level the error rates and the other two come apart. Even a perfect model approves 90% of A and 75% of B.
